description: Section 19 - WA Mining Act (DMIRS-023) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Section 19 – Under Section 19 of the Mining Act (1978) the Minister, or his delegate, may exempt any land, (not being private land or land that is the subject of a mining tenement or of an application therefore), from mining or any specified provisions of the Mining Act. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Its tags are Mining, titles. It offers 4 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, tab shp, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
